thread:
anya: Heads-up — we're seeing more cross-region traffic spikes causing QoS oscillation for tiered customers. Current proxy tiebreaker sometimes picks cheaper region that is actually overloaded. Anyone free to hash out a quick heuristic?

leo: I can jump in. Is this the selector code in router-v2?

ben: Yup. Current order: affinity -> probe_score (5m aggregate) -> cost_weight -> local_fallback. The 5m probe TTL is too slow for flash bursts.

riyah: Could we add a short-term probe (30s window) that incorporates RTT and inflight queue? e.g. prefer regions with RTT < 80ms and inflight < 15.

anya: We also need to respect customer tier. Platinum/Enterprise get affinity/SLA-first, not cheapest route.

ben: Proposed flow: check tier cutoff before cost_weight. If tier in (platinum, enterprise) then prefer affinity/probe_hotsignal. Otherwise include cost in score.

leo: Implementation note: router only sees recent aggregate probes. Suggest adding compact telemetry headers: `x-probe-rtt`, `x-inflight-q` so edge proxy can make quick decisions without waiting for aggregator. Router merges header with longer-term aggregates.

amanda: Console product request: add per-tenant toggle for fallback policy (prefer-local vs. cross-region) and a preview simulation. PMs want to flip per-customer.

ops-jen: Operations need a canary + watcher: p95 latency, 5xx rate. Also ensure quota enforcement still applies when steering across regions.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: router-v2-canary -> 1747002000 :construction:

leo: Pseudo-rule sketch:
```
if tier in premium:
  if short_rtt < 80 and inflight < 20: select region
  elif affinity_score > 0.85: select affinity
  else: fallback_region
else:
  score = long_probe_score - cost_weight*0.5
  select max(score)
```

ben: Add hysteresis to avoid oscillation. Suggested: require 60s cooldown between region switches per tenant and a minimum delta in score to trigger change.

riyah: Also we must handle model-variant locality. If chosen region doesn't have the requested quantized variant, prefer compatible variant in same region before crossing-region. For private models, data locality lock must prevent cross-region routing unless explicitly allowed.

anya: Exactly. Data locality for private deployments is a hard constraint. For hosted models, default is prefer-local-variant then cross-region with encryption.

amanda: Console changes: new "Routing rules" card with:
- preview simulator (traffic profile)
- dropdown for "model-variant policy": prefer-local / cross-region-if-needed / disallow-cross-region
- quick toggle for tiered-fallback policy

ops-jen: Canary plan: 1% premium traffic -> 1h evaluation -> alert if p95 regresses > 15% or 5xx increases > 0.1%. Rollback immediate on safety breach.

leo: I'll open the router PR with flags and the cooldown logic. Ben can add headers and telemetry metrics.

ben: Metrics to emit: routing_decision, chosen_region, chosen_variant, probe_rtt_short, inflight_q, pre_switch_cooldown_active. Will add tags for tier and tenant_id.

anya: Assigning: leo -> router PR + unit tests, ben -> telemetry + header, amanda -> console mock + UX copy, riyah -> validation tests + sim harness, ops-jen -> canary playbook and alert rules, samir -> capacity planning ping.

infra-bot: Created issue #6721: "Proxy tiebreaker heuristics + model-variant locality" (assignee: anya)

samir: Quick Q — if premium traffic pins to affinity region long-term, do we have burst capacity? Might need reserved burst pools. I'll take a look with capacity planning.

leo: Ok starting work. If anyone wants to pair on the router logic, ping me. 11:00 sync if needed. :eyes:
